verdict.rationale: Navan documents its own building blocks for coded spend. These include receipt scanning, connected corporate cards, expense management, custom-field (company fields) management, accounting preferences and ERP settings with per-transaction activity history, and ERP integrations. Spend can also be broken down by vendor and category. However, the pack never shows transactions being coded automatically at the point of spend with merchant, category, memo and receipt attached, or any month-end close workflow. Missing for 10: explicit real-time coding of transactions at swipe, memo capture, automatic receipt matching to card transactions, close/review workflow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, spend is coded as it happens — merchant, category, memo, receipt — so month-end close is a review, not an archaeology dig
